_comment: Single source of truth for vendored ffmpeg/ffprobe/exiftool binaries: CI verifies sha256 against this file when fetching from the deps release, and the app's About screen reads the version fields. Regenerate by re-running the one-time vendoring steps in solve_dependencies.md.

macos.hevc_verify_note: ffmpeg -encoders shows libx265 and hevc_videotoolbox; ffmpeg -codecs shows hevc decode+encode

exiftool.license: Perl Artistic License 1.0 / GPL (dual, upstream's choice of terms); UWMedia redistributes under GPL v3 for the Windows package (as shipped by upstream) and under the same dual terms for the macOS/Linux script

macos.runtime_requirement: system perl (present by default on macOS)
macos.contents: exiftool script + lib/Image/ExifTool module tree, unmodified upstream

windows.runtime_requirement: none - self-contained (ships its own bundled Perl interpreter + DLLs in exiftool_files/, not system Perl)
windows.contents: exiftool(-k).exe launcher + exiftool_files/ (bundled perl.exe, perl532.dll, exiftool.pl, lib/), unmodified upstream official Windows package

linux.runtime_requirement: system perl (present by default on virtually every Linux distro)
linux.contents: exiftool script + lib/Image/ExifTool module tree, unmodified upstream
